A charm that grants the Convert
Element skill.

SkillLevels.2: Increases additional dragon damage and increases dragon attack.
SkillLevels.3: Further increases additional dragon damage and greatly increases dragon attack.

CraftingItems.Name: Arkveld Horn+
CraftingItems.Description: A sharp, pointed Arkveld horn. So menacing, its mere sight dispirits any who must stand against it.

CraftingItems.Name: Arkveld Gem

Hope Charm.Name: Hope Charm

A charm that grants the Self-
Improvement and Recovery Up
skills.

Skills.SkillExplain: Increases the amount recovered when restoring health.

SkillLevels.2: Moderately increases recovery.

A charm that grants the Tool
Specialist skill.

Rice Ball Charm.Name: Rice Ball Charm
Rice Ball Charm.Description:
A charm that grants the
Rice Ball skill.
(Arena Quests only.)

Skills.SkillExplain: Increases the attack power of Akuma actions and stun damage.

Unknown Charm.Name: Unknown Charm
Unknown Charm.Description:
A talisman of indeterminable
age. Said to draw out the
holder's hidden strengths.

Historical Charm.Name: Historical Charm
Historical Charm.Description:
An odd talisman that was written
about in historical texts. Its glow
contains the depths of the past.

Secret Charm.Name: Secret Charm
Secret Charm.Description:
A talisman containing untold
secrets of history. The holder will
one day see the world's abyss.

Golden Age Charm.Name: Golden Age Charm
Golden Age Charm.Description:
A talisman inscribed with the
wisdom of an advanced culture.
Offers a glimpse into an era
of legends.
